subject: serving static resources while using the list style of runApp()

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: serving static resources while using the list style of runApp()
parts:
Hi,

In an old-school app (with a ui.R and server.R) I can have static resources in the www directory, so then I could do things like:
img(src="foo.jpg") 
which would serve www/foo.jpg.

If I instead invoke runApp with a list, like so:

runApp(list(ui=..., server=...))

...I can no longer do this. How do I serve static resources in this style of runApp() invocation?

Thanks,
Dan

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: Re: serving static resources while using the list style of runApp()
parts:
Looks like the answer is found in
?addResourcePath

Thanks,
Dan
